notes: Six hanging lights are visible: two small bulbs by the skylight, two lower bulbs next to brass lanterns at the bottom, and two large chain-hung glowing globes in the foreground at the far left (U1) and far right (U2). The audit's suggested 'upper-left' would be wrong (the skylight bulbs are higher); refs now say far left / far right and call them globe lights. The U2 globe is already a white opal-like glass globe, so 'add an opal-glass shade' was near no-op; payload changed to a red silk tassel hanging from it.
